_doc: Structure of a creator's style. Copied to looks/<name>/look.json and filled ONLY by the « style-de-montage » skill, from the creator's own answers : their edited video (or a reference video whose editing they like, measured by tools/analyse_style.py), their brand, and their picks on A/B/C choice videos. Every empty value means « not chosen yet » : the engine then does the neutral thing (no zoom, no sound effect, no music, no keyword). Each chosen value carries a _why with the creator's answer and the date.

brand._doc: Asked at step 2 (site, landing page, or colours / fonts / logo). accent = colour of the strong word and of the numbered cards ; background = full-screen visuals ; title_family = font of keywords and titles (a family of assets/fonts, or added in fonts : [{"family", "file", "weight"}] with its licence file).

framing._doc: Framings a cut alternates between. Names : A / B = whole picture of camera A (front) / B (side), At / Bt = tight, Att / Btt = very tight ; zoom = crop factor of each tight framing. Asked with the « cadrages » choice video (one fixed framing / two / three).

cut._doc: Rhythm. max_pause : a silence longer than this inside a sentence is shortened to pause_keep. shot_target / min_shot / max_shot : a long sentence is split into shots of about shot_target s. cam_hold {"A": s, "B": s} : with two phones, the camera only changes after it has been seen this long. Measured on the creator's video, or asked with the « rythme » choice video.

zoom._doc: Zooms inside a shot (100 = none). default : slow push from -> to over every shot (alternate : one shot in, the next out). accent : quick eased zoom on a strong word. dezoom : quick zoom out at the start of a shot. Asked with the « zooms » choice video (none / light / strong).

sound._doc: Sound effects : cues [{"on": "keyword or icon pop" | "visual entrance" | "every face cut", "file": "<assets/sfx file>", "db": -22, "lead": 0.1}]. Empty = no sound effect. Asked with the « sons » choice video (none / soft / marked). insert_sounds : the small sounds built into some visuals (typing, pops of a list), false = silent.

music._doc: palette [{file, name, good_from, credit}] = the tracks the creator chose (tools/musique.py palette). under_lu = how many LU the music sits under the voice (intro, then body). open {riser, impact, start_hit} / close (a sound file ending the intro) / change_on_chapter / outro {fade} : only if the creator chose them. Empty palette = no music. Asked with the « musique » choice video (3 different moods).

keywords._doc: Words on screen : "none", "simple" (white, light) or "gras" (heavy capitals, strong word in the accent colour). Always the speaker's own words. Asked with the « mots » choice video.
